name: Chinese Grand Prix
sources_2026_10_03: formula1.com race report and official race result, FIA final race classification, Sky Sports, Autosport; all 2026-03-15. Verified 2026-10-03 against the FIA final classification, final starting grid and qualifying classification: Norris, Piastri, Bortoleto and Albon DNF->DNS; 12 grid slots corrected (Albon pit lane); qualifying positions and missing times filled. Qualifying positions P18-P22 set to the FIA final qualifying classification (Doc. 62): Albon qualified 18th before his pit-lane start, so Alonso, Bottas, Stroll and Perez are 19th to 22nd.
summary: Kimi Antonelli won by 5.515s from George Russell for his maiden Grand Prix victory, leading a Mercedes 1-2 after briefly losing the start to Lewis Hamilton. Lance Stroll's stopped Aston Martin triggered the only Safety Car; Antonelli retained the lead after the pit cycle while Russell fell behind both Ferraris on cold tyres before recovering. Hamilton beat Charles Leclerc in a close Ferrari fight for his first Ferrari Grand Prix podium, and Oliver Bearman recovered from P10 to fifth. Seven cars failed to finish, including three race retirements and four DNS entries; Esteban Ocon served a 10-second penalty for colliding with Franco Colapinto.
